creative_improvements.idea: Execution-time condition revalidation — recheck RSI at trade open, not just detection
creative_improvements.rationale: 37% of 7d trades fire on stale signals. DOT SHORT entered RSI=70.14 > SHORT_RSI_CEILING=65. Filter ran at detection time (RSI was valid) but by execution time RSI had moved. Simple recheck in signal_compactor would catch this.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Block ~5-10% of losing trades that enter on stale conditions

creative_improvements.idea: EXTREME regime SHORT-only filter — block LONG entries in EXTREME, keep SHORT
creative_improvements.rationale: EXTREME regime 7d: 102T 57.8%WR +$0.90. SHORT dominates (+$1.52 from SHORT signals). LONG losers cluster in EXTREME (open-skies+, trend_purity+). SHORT works in EXTREME because extreme volatility = momentum continuation.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Block ~$0.50-1.00/7d of LONG losses in EXTREME
